balls.text: yorker at middle stump, jammed past the non-striker and to long-on's right. Throw is off by a few inches at the striker's end and they complete the second as a result
inside edge past short fine. Length ball outside off, steps out and has a hack across the line. Rewarded for his intent
short of long-off and too wide of extra cover running back. Full ball outside off, clears the front leg and looks to drill this straight. Comes off the toe-end
slower ball at a length on off stump, shapes for the slog sweep and gets a thick inside edge to short fine
in-dipping yorker at leg stump. Jammed down to long-on
full slower ball outside off, mistimed slog sweep, along the floor to deep midwicket

Ashwin could be run-out here. Slower ball, full and outside off stump. Swings for it and gets it towards long-off off the cue-end. Woakes calls for the second, Ashwin turns for it. Miller is very confident though, takes his time with the pick up, winds up his arm and sends a lovely throw on the bounce to Samson. Ashwin is grounding the bat but he's well short
wide yorker outside off gone wrong, Samson dives to stop one-handed to his right
wide yorker outside off, his legs are split as he reaches out for this. Manages to stab it meekly enough that long-off can't stop the second
beaten on the hoick. Short of a length cutter at middle stump. Ashwin plays himself, jumping into the off side then back into the leg side and swinging well past this rising ball over middle stump
lofted over backward point. Not a great ball with three fielders in the circle square on the off side - short and wide and across him with the angle. Ashwin hangs back and slices it

sneaks through from under the sweep and hits off stump. Beautifully done. Full and dipping this time. Curran's looking to swipe into the leg side but ends up jamming his bat into the pitch. Nowhere near it as that bounces past his back knee and tonks off stump
oh that is thundered past extra cover. Full, loopy slower ball. Curran waits on it and gets his weight into that on the front foot, and then some
yorker at middle stump, dug out to long-on
slower ball, short of a length at the stumps. Can't get his back foot punch through cover, it trickles towards long-on off the inside half
full slower ball outside off, big slog at that, comes off the low part of the bat and sprints out to long-on
slower ball at a length on off stump, tapped to extra cover's right
beats short third to the right. Short of a length and into the stumps. Arches backwards and gets this late cut where he wants
good length just outside off, punched on the rise to extra cover
slower ball, short of a length outside off. Punched to long-off on the back foot
good length and quickly past the outside edge as he looks to slice that

just short of long-off where Miller nearly pulls off a stunner. Full offcutter at middle stump, closes the face early on the flick and gets a leading edge. Miller sprints in and to his right, can only get one hand on that with a slide at it
just short of short third. Cutter at a length outside off, gets low for the drive and then follows this with his hands. Thick outside edge
offcutter at a length on off stump, backs away and carves to sweeper cover
oh that is sweetly placed. Full offcutter outside off. Clears the front leg, watches closely and adjusts the batswing for the slower ball. Lofts it over extra cover
good length at middle stump, deep in the crease as he stabs this to deep midwicket
short and just outside off, backs away and punches to sweeper cover
full at off stump, steps out and flicks straight to midwicket
full outside off, jammed to midwicket off the front foot
short of a length and just outside off, chopped to sweeper cover

good length and sliding on from outside off, looks to drive for the legbreak, this ends up to midwicket's left. And a direct hit from Unadkat would have been a wicket. The bowler nowhere neat the stumps to pick up the under-arm flick from Unadkat
low full toss into leg stump, timed nicely on the flick to deep midwicket's left. Vohra cleans up

and it is taken at mid-on. Tewatia pumps his fists, this is a very good catch. Length and slanted into middle stump. He looks to loft that on the rise over the infielder and ends up getting it high on the bat. Tewatia tracks it over his right shoulder and keeps his balance after stretching to grab this
slower length ball wide outside off, reaches out and has a slash at that. Inside edge rolls through to the keeper
short of a length at leg stump, clipped to deep square off the hips
oh that's a nice looking shot. Short of a length ball outside off, slammed into the pitch and sitting up nicely for a pull off the front foot. Into the midwicket boundary
good length and wide outside off, beaten on the attempted square drive
good length legbreak at off stump, punched back to the bowler off the front foot
short of a length at middle stump, punched to long-on off the back foot
good length slider at middle stump, leans in and punches to long-on
inside edge as he looks to send this over the roof at midwicket. Full slider at middle stump that
length and at off stump, sliding on. Pushed back to the bowler
big lbw appeal but that is going down. Length and sliding into the pad, beating him on the sweep
full legbreak outside off, drilled down to long-off
legbreak, at a length and on off stump. Gets low and sweeps confidently to deep square's left

direct hit from Parag and Pant isn't even bothering to wait. Full and loopy at the stumps. He turns it pitch side on the leg side, and takes off to steal the run. Parag gets to it quickly, swivels rapidly from his right side and takes down the stumps at the non-striker's end before breaking into dance. He has haulted a very dangerous looking innings from Delhi's captain
full legbreak at off stump, driven to long-off

wants to muscle this as if he's offended by Parag's side-arm action. Gone too hard at it after stepping out and looking to go inside out. Comes off the inside of the bat and ends up to deep midwicket's right. They've checked to see if his arm was below the waits during delivery. It wasn't
legbreak, yorker length at middle stump. Jammed down to long-on

unlucky for Parag at sweeper cover. Pant brings up fifty. Slower ball, short and wide outside off. Cut furiously to Parag's right. He sprints, slides, gets a his hand on that. But the momentum takes it into his shins as he's touching the boundary padding
beaten on the drive. Looks like he was driving for the one that cuts back in from a length. Was caught inside the line as this skidded straight on outside off
slower ball at a length on middle, watches it closely and glances to fine leg
bouncer down leg side, left alone
short of a length at the stumps, a cutter, punched to long-on off the back foot
short and wide outside off, beaten on the cut

Parag is off balance but manages to drag that into play. It was a sweet shot, a pick-up from leg stump. But it was to Parag at deep backward square. He judged it alright, took a step back and managed to get two hands on that. Even caught it with a well-timed jump, but was aware enough that he couldn't stay on his feet. Quickly pushed it back into play

through the legs of Sakariya at sweeper! Tewatia drops another one short outside off, Pant slaughters it off the back foot once again. Sakariya makes the ground to his left and then lets it through from between his legs. 20 off the over
good length outside off, sliding away. Leans in for the flick and gets a leading edge. Cover misfields to the right and they get a second now. That spun away from Vohra on the floor
full on middle stump, leans in and clips this to deep square's right

not finding his length at all. That is fear, really, at bowling to Pant. Attempted slider, dropped very short and wide outside off. Waits on that and continues to show off his range with the cut - this one is past extra cover and to long-off's right
dropped short, possibly a googly this time, but enough width again for Pant to scythe down on it. This time to sweeper's left
poor ball to start. Short and wide outside off, Pant rocks back and slaps it to sweeper's left
short of a length cutter outside off, punched with the angle to sweeper cover
offcutter at a length on leg stump, gets forward and pokes this into vacant midwicket with soft hands
full offcutter at middle stump, leans in for the drive and adjusts to pat this to midwicket
good length and just outside off, gets forward to defend for the angle. It straightens and catches the inside of the bat
good length and rapped on the front pad as he looks to defend. Beaten on the inside edge
good length and angled into off stump, hangs the bat out in front for the drive on the rise. Leading edge to sweeper's left
short and just outside off, punched to sweeper cover
good length, wide of the crease, side-arm release and skidding in at off stump. Defended onto the boot
short of a length outside off, punched to long-on off the back foot
short and wide outside off, cut to sweeper cover
short of a length and just outside off, punched to extra cover off the back foot
tries his side-arm action and loses control. Lobbed too wide outside off
starts with an offbreak, it is short and very wide outside off. Slapped to sweeper's right
a bouncer, wide outside off stump. Reaches out for the upper cut and is beaten
short of a length at off stump, defended off the back foot
nicely done. Short of a length and rising in the corridor. Gets on his toes to cover the bounce on that and dabs it to third man's left
good length at off stump, 140kph, defended off the back foot
length ball tails in very late after he plants the front foot out. But he adjusts well and offers a full enough face on that, leans in, and clips it past midwicket
full and just outside off, driven on the up to sweeper cover
cutter at a length on off stump, solidly blocked on the front foot

Buttler runs back from short extra and grabs that! This is terrific bowling from RR. Delhi have absolutely no answers right now. Another cutter, landed at a length just outside off. Stoinis has shaped for the drive on the up and then has to check the shot. It loops over Buttler, who has to go back and slightly to his right. Tracks it nicely over his shoulders and stretches his arms to grab it
cuts past the outside edge. There is grip in this surface. Mutafiz with the trademark cutter at a length on middle stump, Stoinis looks to defend on the front foot and that is past him
full and just outside off, driven off the front foot to mid-off
short of a length and tight in the corridor, hurriedly punched to point
short of a length and into off stump, defended into the covers
short of a length at off stump, defended on the back foot

chipped straight back to the bowler! Unadkat savouring this new role! The domestic stalwart we've known is surely on display tonight. A slower ball at length, just outside off. Rahane seemed to be advancing but pulled out of his shot - don't know what exactly it was meant to be - and could only jab this back with hard hands down the pitch
beats the inside edge. Good length ball just outside off. Rahane looks to punch for the angle, but that's landed on the seam and straightened
slower length ball outside off, cutting into him. Plants the front leg out and drags that with a mistimed slog
good length and just outside off, jabbed on the front foot
good length and just outside off, brings down an angled bat on the forward block and gets a thick edge that beats short third
good length and slanted into leg stump. Flicked straight to short fine
full and just outside off, looks to drive with the angle, gets an inside edge to short fine's right
drilled past mid-off. Full slower ball outside off, big backlift and then comes down hard on this drive. It bounces past the diving fielder
full and down leg side, beaten on the flick
low full toss outside off, reaches out and carves to sweeper point
good length and just outside off, nicely behind the line as he glances to deep square
length and in at middle stump, reaches out and flicks to deep square's left
good length and just outside off, plants the front leg across off and whips this to mid-on
good length and wobbling outside off, left alone
inswinging good length ball outside off, blocked on the front foot
short of a length and just outside off, angled into the corridor this time. Punches off the back foot, bottom hand comes off as he does that. It's past backward point

beaten on the drive! Oh that was so close. Many bowlers have been on hat-tricks in this edition already, Unadkat's come close to being the first to do it. Moves it away from a good length outside off, Pant was looking to drive on the up through cover

Samson flies to his right to hold on! Unadkat now on a hat-trick. Looks like another slower ball. Good length just outside off, Dhawan shuffles for the ramp but is caught in an awkward and upright position as he executes it. Which is why I suspect that was a slower one. But we'll take a look at that later. He has ended up getting a thick edge and Samson goes one-handed, stretching high and to his right to grab this. Superb from the RR captain. Addendum: It wasn't a slower ball, it was an outswinger
oh nicely put away. Short ball at 127kph, up at the ribs. Nicely on top of the bounce of this and keeps the hook down, gets it past short fine
length and just outside off, 130.5kph, half a stride across and clipped to midwicket
full outswinger in the corridor, watches that closely and caresses towards mid-off
walks down at the first ball, length and across him. Has a drive on the rise and gets a thick edge down to third man
full and into the corridor, 133kph. Leans in and flicks to mid-on's left
good length and very wide outside off, 128kph, Dhawan reaches out and slaps it on the rise past extra cover

taken at backward point! Unadkat changes it up early. A full slower ball at off stump. Shaw stuck in the crease, trying to drill this across the line through midwicket. Gets a leading edge and it flies comfortably to Miller there
short and wide outside off, cut to sweeper point
short of a length just outside off, punched to backward point off the back foot
short of a length outside off, steps out and steers this to point with an angled bat
good length and at off stump, shuffles and turns it into the leg side off the back foot
good length and just outside off, dropped into the covers with soft hands
good length, inswinger from outside off. Waits on the front foot and jabs to sweeper cover
good length and wobbly, wide outside off. Dhawan shuffles and leaves
short of a length and just outside off, defended into the covers
length and into middle stump, turned through square leg off the back foot

that looks very very close on lbw. It's turned down. They won't review. Big inswinger this time and Shaw is beaten on the inside edge, this time expecting the angle away from him. Tucked on the glance, jumping as he's struck on the back thigh. Perhaps that was high
beaten on the outside edge. Plays for the one shaping into him but this goes away with the angle as he looks to punch
wins it with a six! IPL's most expensive man has finished this off in style for Rajasthan. A knee-high full toss at leg stump, he stands tall and sends that on its way over deep square
overpitched outside off, crunched firmly but straight to extra cover. That was hit sweetly, whew
swung over deep square! It's a slower ball gone woefully wrong! Short legcutter, too short. Sitting up like it's swinging practice. And swing he does
they sneak the second from sweeper cover. Yorker length at off, jammed to sweeper's right and Prithvi Shaw is getting glares from a couple of people after being caught flat-footed
length outside off, jabbed into the covers

instinctive hoick, massive hoick! Morris is not really in control here, he's had a swing and he's gotten it right off the middle. It's a length ball tucking him up at the mid-riff and he simply whips the bat at that. It pings off rapidly over the long leg boundary

outside edge on a length ball outside off. Was looking to slog this into the leg side and got a leading edge. Avesh cleans up to his left at third man. Nearly falls over the line but has the presence of mind to flick that back in with his left hand
beaten. Oh that was in the slot and Morris was caught out of position. Overpitched just outside off, Morris' leg is moving well away from the ball, into the leg side. Mid-off was in, he's missed out
short of a length and rising outside off, Morris is beaten for pace as he swings across the line of this
bludgeoned over midwicket! Attempted legcutter is picked. It's in the slot. Morris' front leg is out of the way and his swing through this is clean and powerful
slower short ball outside off, subdued pull down to long-on
low full toss at middle stump, looks to drive down the ground, inside edge onto boot
slower short ball at middle stump, looks to pull and ends up slicing that over the keeper. Fine leg cleans up to the right
length ball outside off, tails in late and encumbers his attempted swing through the line. Off the inside half to long-on and he is unhappy
slower ball at a length on leg stump, pushed into the leg side with soft hands

Unadkat slips and it seems like it's an unfortunate end, but the script has completely flipped! Pant doesn't gather the ball. Short of a length ball heaved off the inside edge to deep midwicket. Unadkat was sent back trying to go for the second, slipped, fell and made a despairing dive. It was a straightforward throw to Pant who was over-eager and has broken the stumps without gathering the ball
full outside off, driven along the floor to long-off
short and wide outside off, carved to third man's right off the back foot
length outside off, beaten as he looks to run that down with an open face
swung over deep backward square! Short and into the body, swivels languidly and sends that over the boundary with some class
short and rising sharply outside off, beats the outside edge as he tries to stab to third man
length at middle stump, slogged on the bounce to long-on
short and just outside off, chopped to third man's right

taken at long-on! Avesh has his revenge! What a sequence it's been, these last three balls. He goes slightly fuller and it looks like that dips towards off stump very late as Miller clears the front leg to try and loft him straight. Gets it off the toe end and is caught well inside the boundary

pummeled over square leg! That sounded like a gunshot. Two in two after none in 212. Put Avesh under pressure with the previous ball, cashes in now. Length at leg stump and a lovely swing to lift this far, far into the stands
clears deep backward square. Miller decides to take on Avesh for the first six of the match! Length ball at middle stump, shuffles to create swinging room and picks that up
length and just outside off, hurried punch into the covers off the back foot

length and wide outside off, mistimed drive on the rise, off the toe-end to extra cover. But that brings up fifty for Miller. He's waited a long long time to find a place in this XI, and he's singlehandedly keeping them alive tonight
length ball in the corridor, feet rooted as he looks to drive on the up and is beaten on the outside edge
taken by midwicket running in. Short of a length and onto him quickly as he shapes to pull. Ends up slicing that and Lalit jogs in to hold onto that
length at the pads, whipped out to deep square
full and at middle stump, driven to long-on
length and just outside off, looks to drive through cover, gets it off the inside half to long-on's left
yorker length at off stump, jammed down to long-off
oh superb! Low full toss wide outside off, he gets across, gets low and then sweeps him between square leg and short fine. Lovely wrists
full and just outside off, mistimed slog, off the thick inside edge to deep midwicket
slower ball, short of a length outside off. Chopped to sweeper's right
slapped over mid-off. Short of a length ball outside off, gets a stride out at that and flat-bats this on the rise
length ball wide outside off, slashed out to sweeper cover on the up
length ball outside off, shuffles and swings across the line. Cops that on the thigh guard
full slower ball at off stump, driven down to long-on
overpitched outside off, mistimed drive to long-off's left
low full toss outside off, follows that with his hands and then whips across it to get that into the midwicket boundary
get out of the way! Wow, that is a lethal hit. Pretty ordinary delivery - full and lobbed into his swinging arc outside off. He's brutalised that with the drive, rapidly into the long-off boundary
pulled into the square leg boundary yet again. Short at leg stump, lined that up nicely and hit it into the ground
length at leg stump, flicked out to deep square
length outside off, pushed to point off the front foot
slower short ball wide outside off, cut to sweeper cover
good length and just outside off, defended to extra cover's left
full and just outside off, patted to extra cover off the front foot
short of a length and just outside off, defended to extra cover
length and pushed wide outside off again, beaten on the square drive
short of a length and wide outside off, beaten on the slash
length and tossed up at middle stump, nervous prod off the front foot. Thick inside edge to short fine's right
length and into the pads, flicked to deep square
short of a length and tight at the stumps. Gets deep for the flick, inside edge onto boot
short of a length and sliding into the pads as he looks to whip that square
short of a length at off stump, punched to long-on off the back foot
length at middle stump, steps out and drives firmly at long-on
length at leg stump, whipped out to deep square
scythed wide of mid-off. Short of a length and wide outside off. Chucks his hands at this. It comes off the toe-end, but it is wide of the fielder
nicely put away. Short at off stump, nicely on top of that and swivels to pull well in front of deep square
in the air but safely away from backward point. Length ball pushed across off stump, swishes at that and gets it to third man

taken at extra cover! Parag looks for the loft over mid-off and gets it off the toe-end. It's a slower ball. It's full and outside off, there for the loft it it is regular paced. But it is not. His bottom hand comes off. Hangs high for Dhawan and Royals are sinking rapidly now
short of a length at leg stump, swivels for the short-arm pull to fine leg's right
slider at a length outside off, slightly low-arm action. Punched into the covers
carrom ball at a length on middle stump, punched towards long-on off the inside half
short of a length outside off, steps out and stabs into the leg side with a closed face
full and sliding in at the stumps, defended down the pitch
short and just outside off, punched firmly to sweeper off the back foot
short of a length and into middle stump, punched to deep midwicket off the back foot
awkward. Very awkward. Short ball hones in on his head and he arches back to try and ramp it over the keeper. Beaten
good length and just outside off, defended to point on the front foot
taken at slip! Dube driving on the up at a length ball that he is not close to. Middle stump line, cutting away and getting steep on him. Feet absolutely rooted. Flies to Dhawan at wide slip
length and just outside off, has a swish as that and gets it off the outside edge into the off side
short of a length at leg stump, clipped to fine leg
length and across off stump. Reaches out for a square drive on the up, gets it to third man's left. Curran makes the ground but the ball ends up past the boundary, using his left palm as a ramp
length at leg stump, punched to long-on off the back foot
good length and sliding on quickly at the stumps. Gets on the back foot and hurriedly punches this into vacant midwicket off the inside half
length at leg stump, flicked to deep backward square
length and into leg stump, leans in and punches to long-on
good length, sliding on in the corridor. Defended into the covers
length ball slides into the pads in front of leg as he looks to flick
slower ball at a length outside off, waits on it and steers it to third man's right
short of a length and skidding on too quickly for him to time this cut, fielder in the covers
nearly chipped to short extra cover. Low full toss outside off, driven off the toe-end and falls short of Stoinis
length at off stump, defended into the covers
oh creamed past the bowler. Length ball slanted into off stump, gets his weight into this with half a stride and offers the full face. Beautiful sound off the bat as this beats mid-off's dive
short of a length outside off, defended towards first slip off the back foot
full at middle stump, shuffles across and flicks to deep square's right
full at middle stump, punched firmly back at the bowler on the bounce
beaten as he feels for this outside off. Length ball pushed across him with the angle
good length at off stump, punched to mid-off's right, Rabada dives to stop
short of a length at leg stump, defended to midwicket
good length at off stump, gets forward to defend and is a little late on it. Inside edge down to fine leg
short of a length at off stump, 142.5kph, defended into the covers
good length and just outside off, punched to mid-off on the up
low full toss outside off, drives to extra cover's left and he can't gather cleanly

taken at slip! I'm back, says Rabada! Hangs this length ball outside off, marginal movement outside off. Samson looks to drive through the line. It carries nicely for Dhawan, high to his left. Rajasthan in familiar territory - lost three wickets in the powerplay quite a few times last season
short of a length and cutting into off stump. Opens the face and runs it to point's left
welcome back, says Sanju. This is overpitched, into the pads. Waits on that and clips languidly through midwicket

inside edge and they have Buttler! Was that the long con from Woakes? Slams it in at a length and brings this one in to Buttler, who has walked into the off side possibly to fetch the awayswinger into the leg side. He's cramped at his body, trying to hurriedly turn it into the leg side, and gets an inside edge that is sailing to Pant's left. The keeper does superbly to grab that with a dive
short of a length outside off, punched into the covers off the back foot

can't clear mid-on this time! Full and at middle stump. Wants to hit that over mid-on but checks his shot for some reason. Did that stop on him? He ends up getting height but not a lot of distance on that, Rabada takes some steps backwards and holds on
full slower ball outside off, that away-drifting knuckle ball again. Picks it, gets behind it and lofts it over mid-on
finally gets a release ball and crunches it. Overpitched and wide outside off, gets low and on his back knee to put this away, elegant as ever
beats him with the away-drifter. Might have been a knuckle ball. Floating and curving away from a length on off stump, catches him with a closed face on the flick
good length and thudding into the pad, 137kph. Looks to whip that behind square off the front foot and can't connect
beaten on the pull this time, was through it too soon. Short and wide outside off and climbing past the top edge
short of a length outside off, brings out the pull but that's onto him quickly. Mistimed towards square leg
short of a length and ripping back in furiously at Vohra as he's caught in front of leg stump trying to glance this. Avesh's lbw appeal turned down
short of a length outside off, rising in the corridor as he shapes to cut. Checks his shot and gets it to point
good length and slanted in at the stumps, nudged to fine leg with the angle
short of a length, rising into the mid-riff and catching the back thigh. Floats to first slip's right
short of a length outside off, aerial chop down to third man
short and wide outside off, sweet timing on the back foot punch but can't beat a diving Lalit Yadav to the left at cover point
good length outside off, steps across off stump and clips this to mid-on
good length and curving away outside off, left alone
short of a length and swung away outside off, left alone
